paralycopodites.scope_limit: Genus-level living reconstruction, not exact fossil individual. Lateral row position and determinate branching use DiMichele and Bateman2020 primary text. Cone and leaf dimensions are illustrative choices near described specimens, not universal fossil ranges. Anatomy pixels are Seward1910 fig186A/B under a historical name linked to Paralycopodites by DiMichele1980; they do not directly demonstrate whole architecture. Exact height, counts, colors and complete outline are artistic.

feature_source_mapping.feature: One columnar main trunk ending in a limited two-leader fork; ten compact lateral systems in two opposite vertical rows on the main trunk, and four continuing those rows on crown axes. Not helical or radial branch whorls.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

feature_source_mapping.feature: Each of fourteen lateral systems forms four unequal terminal axes on a broadly planar anisotomous scaffold; fifty-six slender terminal strobili, small persistent narrow microphylls on twigs and trunk.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

feature_source_mapping.feature: Four subdued basal rhizomorph beginnings. No flowers, fruit, spherical cones, terminal-only Lepidodendron crown, coarse diamond bark armor or invented expansive modern tree roots.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

lyginopteris.scope_limit: Lyginopteris oldhamia whole-habit hypothesis. Primary biomechanical abstract supports a prolonged semi-self-supporting growth phase and later scrambling; Seward original specimen figures support divided lobed foliage and glandular emergences. Dead support is explicit illustrative scene aid, not claimed fossil organ or second living organism. Overall size, exact arrangements, palette and count are art choices.

feature_source_mapping.feature: One slender non-twining leaning/scandent stem supported at a genuine contact by one subordinate dead forked twig. Six sparsely spaced divided fronds on stem, not a basal fern rosette.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

feature_source_mapping.feature: Each frond divides into two fan arms, each with three pinnae bearing six small deeply lobed pinnules:216 pinnules total. Coherent leaf blades, petioles and branches are connected, not floating fan cutouts.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

feature_source_mapping.feature: Twenty-four small scattered gland-base nubs on exposed axis, not oversized nodal bead bunches or microscopic hairs. Sterile specimen; associated Lagenostoma organs not separate assets and not modeled.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

medullosa.scope_limit: One erect self-supporting medullosan whole-habit hypothesis, not universal for Medullosa. Wilson et al2015 Figure6A depicts a Pennsylvania compression-fossil-based erect interpretation, while6B and Wilson/Fischer2011 demonstrate different/lax habits. Original Alberta specimen images corroborate stem and pinna preservation, not a complete fossil tree. Nominal height, module counts, colors and detailed frond outline artistic.

feature_source_mapping.feature: One self-standing limited relatively slender stem with twelve sparse persistent petiole stubs, quiet bare intervals, and six substantial frond petioles. No continuous pineapple-like scale armor or broad buttress root cage.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

feature_source_mapping.feature: Each very large frond divides into two fan arms, each with four pinnae carrying eight elongate rounded pinnules:384 pinnules total. Strong multi-order compound hierarchy and broad spatially spread fans, not a cycad single-pinnate crown.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

feature_source_mapping.feature: Fronds arch outward in different azimuths and elevations. Vegetative educational whole plant: no disputed reproductive structures, flowers, fruit, or extra species.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

cordaites.scope_limit: Conservative genus-level juvenile upland cordaitalean reconstruction. Falcon-Lang/Bashforth2005 primary abstract supports woody upland tree architecture and explicitly sterile reconstruction. Original Seward specimen pixels and Alberta collection text support broad strap leaves and parallel venation. Published giant adult size is NOT equated to chosen juvenile art scene scale. Crown, count and palette artistic.

feature_source_mapping.feature: One straight tapering woody trunk with bare lower half and seven unequal upper woody limbs, each with three distal twigs. Select juvenile upland tree habit, not coastal/mangrove or shrub habit.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

feature_source_mapping.feature: Each twig bears five individual broad simple long ribbon leaves,105 leaves total. Leaves retain near-parallel edges through much of length with a modest rounded-taper tip, gently curved in full spatial depth.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.

feature_source_mapping.feature: Five equal subtle longitudinal material bands cue parallel venation without one dominant midrib. No compound palm/fern fronds, conifer needle sprays, reproductive organs or prop roots.
feature_source_mapping.interpretation: Module counts, detailed positions and art dimensions not fossil measurements.
